ops.body:
- **T? [owner] A loop's two ends as one combined mark** (2026-11-20)
  Area: map. Seen: `qol-21-loop-card-390.png`, `qol-21-loop-card-320.png`, `qol-20-loop-held-390.png` (the `qol` journey, `/tend map`, Nov 20): a walk that ends 3 m from where it began draws the end's bullseye over the start (`tend map audit 25`), and the start's green shows only as a crescent beside it (the lenses' ux-reviewer 5, steward's silent 1). Rests on: the owner's answer in person, Nov 20, "One combined mark (Recommended)" (decision 0244); E-map-1 ("the two marked by shape, not colour alone").
  Recommended: when the start and the end fall within one marker's diameter on screen, one mark: the start's hollow ring (the trace's green) as a halo around the end's bullseye (`ENDS_RING_PAINT`, `ENDS_PAINT`, `map/types.ts`); apart, the two marks as now. Judged on screen, so the ends are sent again as the zoom changes, on both maps (`traceEnds` with a pure "together at this scale" rule, `WalkMap.web.tsx`, `WalkMap.native.tsx`): four source files, past the two this run was allowed, so it waits for a build. /vision: aligned (Return: the walk's shape told truthfully; no word, count or control added).
  Precedent: Strava draws a loop's start and finish flags over each other (from memory, not yet recorded); none found in `docs/research/adjacent-apps.md` ("Replay a walk; moments on a map" names no app's two ends).
  Otherwise: the end drawn over the start as now, with the start's ring widened so it shows whole around it at every zoom (one paint, no zoom rule).
  Nov 20: the owner's yes, in person, "One combined mark (Recommended)" (decision 0244). Waits for a build.

- **QL16's words and the map rule's "Distances in words" after `tend map 23`** (Nov 20; decision 0244, the owner's "Keep it in the map (Recommended)"). What ships: a view takes its distance formatters from `useDistance()` (`lib/useUnits`), bound to the units, or passes the units it holds; `destLine` and `passNote` take the units. Under the React Compiler (decision 0207) a view that only calls `useUnits()` is redrawn on a switch but keeps each line it memoized, so Explore's tile said "4.0 km away" while its spoken label said "2.5 mi away". Still saying the old: `specs/quality-of-life/spec.md` l.45, QL16 ("`useUnits()` in the components that format"); `.claude/rules/map.md` l.71, "Distances in words" (a line that builds a distance "better calls `formatDistance`, which also follows the units setting"), and `.claude/rules/tabs-and-home.md`'s units line ("`useUnits()` subscribes a component … calls `useUnits()` so it redraws"). The loop only adds to a rule file (0135) and never edits a spec (the `/tend map` lenses' auditor 2).

- **`specs/quality-of-life/spec.md` l.42 (QL13) says "until then the locale default shows"** (Nov 20). What ships: the units store starts at km until `loadUnits` reads meta at launch (`src/lib/units.ts` l.30-32, held by the unit test "QL13 regression: a fresh store starts at km, whatever the machine", so pure code and `npm test` never read the machine's locale), so a miles user's first frames say km. Either the words follow the build, or the app's instance sets the locale's default on import (filed `[loop]` in `docs/DEFERRED.md`, "Map, walk screen and motion polish") (the `/tend map` lenses' auditor 4).

**Nov 20, `/tend map --deploy=main`, a whole, uncapped sweep** (opened from `e9cb0f18`; lenses 0-7 all run; the last of decision 0229's whole sweeps, the fourth under the expectation lens, decision 0236). Before the review: the diff review's fixes and this digest's last word follow it.
- Lens 0: map had no line; five drafted (`docs/expectations/map.md`, proposed), reworded by the steward (E5, north in one tap, dropped for the pins' shape as well as colour) and answered by the owner in person ("Ratify as drafted", decision 0244). E-map-1, 2 and 4 met by their `qol` checks (T16's shapes, QL3's tap on the end, QL10); E-map-3 failed at the lens (Explore's tiles kept km after a switch to miles) and is met since `tend map 23`, its check moved to that e2e; E-map-5 failed, its check pending, its defect DEFERRED's photo and video discs under deuteranopia (noted there).
- Lenses: 1, the area's journeys (`qol`, `palette`) and the maps of `outing` and `planner`, with a units probe, to the ux-reviewer and the steward; 2-4 read from the code, the specs and the rule files; 5, the auditor; 6, `check:vision --list` clean on the area's files; 7, DEFERRED's nineteen `[loop]` items of the area read (the `alternates` one re-measured with `perf-walk`: gone).
- Shipped: `tend map 22` a journey's step failures read "step <name>: …" (qol, edit; deletion's walk-delete check opens on its ids), so a line can name qol's checks; `23` Explore's tiles and card, Navigate's settings and its strip take formatters bound to the units (`useDistance`), the React Compiler having kept the old units; `24` Plan an outing's map shows its scale bar and credits and frames the journey above its sheet; `25` a pin standing on the start marker opens with a tap (QL3).
- Filed: T50 (a loop's two ends as one combined mark, the owner's yes, waiting for a build); `[loop]` in "Map, walk screen and motion polish": tend map 23's rest (the walk screen, the replay, the home sheet, the gap's drawing; medium), the formatters' default units, Explore's open credits at 320, the audit 35 picture, Explore's Find me when refused, the scale bar before the first view, Chronicle's empty map at z22, a late Locate fix undoing a pick, the units store's first frames in km; notes on the credits under Chronicle's notice (worse than filed) and E-map-5 on the deuteranopia item; the comments item reworded and the `alternates` item removed; QL16's and QL13's words and the map rule's units line in "Open before the loop".
- The balance: outgrowing its base (ten areas rough); no `G` from lens 0 (E-map-5's growth is the filed deuteranopia item). The area stays `rough`: tend map 23's rest is a medium left filed.
